title: 🫵 STOP BLAMING BAD LUCK.
paragraphs: Body: Everything in your life is a reflection of choices you have made. If you want different results, make different choices. 🪞🌱
We love to blame the devil, the economy, or our upbringing for where we are. But the hard truth? Most of the time, we are eating the fruit of seeds we planted.
You cannot pray for a harvest of health while planting seeds of laziness. You cannot pray for peace while choosing conflict.

The Good News? Since your choices got you here, new choices can get you out. God has given you the power of free will. Stop waiting for a miracle and start making better decisions. Your future is hidden in your daily routine.
Change the seed, and you will change the harvest. 🔄🌾
"Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows." — Galatians 6:7 (NIV)
Your Move: Type "NEW SEEDS" if you are taking responsibility for your harvest today! 👇🚜
